create_quote.description: Recheck live price and stock for selected lines or a stored fulfilment plan, then lock fixed net EUR prices until expires_at (at most 30 minutes). Supply exactly one of lines, plan_ref {lookup_id, plan_index} or basket_ref {basket_lookup_id}. A basket reference selects its stored deduplicated lines, preserves ingredient constraints and uncovered warnings, and records all-or-none local simulation atomicity on its order; plan_index is zero-based, need_ref defaults to the plan lookup. Explicit lines REQUIRE need_ref to a stored lookup, otherwise 422 NEED_REF_REQUIRED. Current customer standing constraints are unioned with the stored request at quotation, placement and approval. Partial-plan uncovered warnings persist into ordering. Registered agents may quote only for customers in their mandate (CUSTOMER_NOT_IN_MANDATE); unregistered agents receive AGENT_NOT_REGISTERED on lookup, quote and order. Earlier unversioned signatures remain usable until expiry; kid names a public key at /.well-known/jwks.json. Offline: scripts/verify_quote.py quote.json --jwks jwks.json --customer ID. price_commitment=gateway-locked. Cached command replays revalidate the bound mandate and customer scope. Derived forward navigation lists in links are outside immutable signed evidence. No negotiation. Accounts: the credential binds a tenant, connection and allowed customers. GET /v1/connect/catalog lists client setup and available audiences; humans sign in at /v1/auth/login and manage their own tenant at /v1/tenant. Sign-up at /v1/auth/signup stores a business profile and sourced guardrail preset; get_agent_context and transaction context expose that tenant's snapshot. Hospital/school orders require claims and allergen exclusions (409 CONSTRAINTS_REQUIRED). Human approvals enforce tenant thresholds (403 APPROVAL_LIMIT) and independent reviewers (403 FOUR_EYES); four-eyes-off self-approvals are flagged and audited.
